notes.title: Kemono Friends Collaboration Vol.4 Ongoing!
notes.content:
Hi everyone.
This is the Teravit Operation Team.
We're excited to announce that the 4th collaboration event with Kemono Friends will begin on Thursday, September 4, 2025!
In this 4th volume, the Friends Arctic Wolf and Stoat make their debut in the game!
A new area has been unlocked in the collaboration world 'Friends and Floating Island Memories,' and a new mini game world featuring the latest Friends is now available!
A new 'Friends Chat World' will also be available, letting you enjoy voice chats while experiencing the world of Kemono Friends!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41224509/7f4b2e5c093786aa9cd90a0d561a77229be1cecb.png[/img]
[h3]New area unlocked in collaboration world 'Friends and Floating Island Memories'![/h3]
A new area is being unlocked in the Kemono Friends collaboration world 'Friends and Floating Island Memories'!
The new area is a snowy field blanketed in pure white snow. Be sure to visit the collaboration world and discover new encounters!

In the collaboration world 'Friends and Floating Island Memories', you can obtain exclusive avatar parts like the Park Guide Outfit and the Japari Park Official Safari Hat. 

There will also be a special limited time collaboration gacha featuring Friend themed outfits, furniture, and many other items!

[h3]New Friends Mini Game World Available![/h3]
The new mini game world 'Gather! Exciting Snowball Fight' is now available!
A new competitive mini game world is available, where you can have snowball fights with the snow loving new Friends Arctic Wolf and Stoat!
Take on mini games challenges and earn exclusive rewards!

[b]Important Notes[/b]
The skin parts offered may be available again in future campaigns.
[h3]New 'Friends Chat World' With Voice Chat Available[/h3]
To celebrate the opening of the 'Kemono Friends 10th ANNIVERSARY SHOP SPECIAL' at Shinjuku Marui-Men starting Friday, September 5, 2025, a new 'Friends Chat World' will be available!
In this world, players can enjoy voice chats with each other while being immersed in the world of Kemono Friends!
Be sure to take this opportunity to visit the 'Kemono Friends 10th ANNIVERSARY SHOP SPECIAL' and share your thoughts in the Friends Chat World.


[b][Pop Up Store Event Information][/b]
Location: Shinjuku Marui-Men 8F
(5-16-4 Shinjuku, Shinjuku-ku, Tokyo, Japan)
Dates: September 5 (Fri) - September 15 (Mon), 2025
Store Hours: 11:00 - 19:00

Application Period:

notes.title: Notice Regarding the Change to the Voxel Style of Monster Appearances
notes.content:
Hi everyone.
This is the Teravit Operation Team.

The following updates are scheduled to be implemented on Thursday, February 6.

[h3]■ Update Details[/h3]

[b]・All monster appearances will be changed to voxel style.[/b]
Affected objects:
- Various monster spawners
- Spawner diffusion tools
- Event editors
- Various shop NPCs
- Trade NPCs
- Craft NPCs
- Dialogue NPCs
- World portals
As a result of this change, all monsters that appear from objects related to monster appearances you have currently placed will automatically be replaced with the new voxel style.
Please note that after the update, it will no longer be possible to use the pre-update monster appearances.
Thank you for your understanding.

[b]・A new setting, "Action Type," will be added to the Monster Spawner.[/b]
- This option determines the monster's behavior, such as attacking and moving, and allows you to choose between "Standard" and "The Brave 4"
- Some monsters may only have one of these action types available.
- Some monsters may only have one of these action types available.
- "Standard" retains the regular behavior. Most monsters are only compatible with "Standard".
- "The Brave 4" enables more aggressive and powerful behaviors than usual.
Example: The Night Bat's bite attack will now inflict "paralysis".

[h3]■ Monster Appearances After Update[/h3]

On X (formerly Twitter), we are showcasing the updated appearance of the monsters after the update.
We look forward to hearing your thoughts and feedback about the new look and features!

Thank you for your patience while we prepare for this update.
Thank you for your continued support of Teravit.

notes.title: Notice of Completion for Reimbursement Support and Jewel Specification Change
notes.content:
Hi everyone.
This is the Teravit Operation Team.

Regarding the "Reimbursement Support and Jewel Specification Changes" announced at the end of last year, 
we would like to inform you that the corresponding measures have been completed in today's update.
Please see below for further details.

■Support Details 
・"Points (Nintendo Switch)" have been added to the points that can be checked on the Creator's site.
- These points can only be redeemed for free Jewels.
- "Points (Nintendo Switch)" refer to points that are acquired by playing the Nintendo Switch version, such as "Points obtained by creating Worlds" and "Points obtained through trades". If additional ways to earn points are introduced in the future, similar corresponding measures will be taken for those as well.
- For those who have started playing the Nintendo Switch version (hereinafter referred to as Nintendo Switch players), we have converted the points you currently possess at the time of the update to "Points (Nintendo Switch)".
- Even those who are not Nintendo Switch players, for any players who have linked their accounts with the Nintendo Switch version, we have converted the points presumed to be earned through playing the Nintendo Switch version to "Points (Nintendo Switch)" as of November 30, 2023.

・Regarding World building, changes have been made to record whether a build has been done for each World on the Nintendo Switch version and appropriately separate the points obtained.
- For Nintendo Switch players, all previously created Worlds have been set up as worlds started in the Nintendo Switch version, and the points obtained will correspond to "Points (Nintendo Switch)".
- When Worlds under construction on other platforms are built or uploaded on the Nintendo Switch version, the points obtained from that world thereafter will be labeled as "Points (Nintendo Switch)".

・Regarding free Jewels, they can now only be consumed on the platform where they were received, just like paid Jewels.
- For Nintendo Switch players, any free Jewels possessed at the time of the update have been converted into free Jewels that can only be used on the Nintendo Switch version.
- For all other players, any free Jewels in current possession at the time of the update have been converted into complimentary Jewels that can be used on all platforms as a special exception this time.

・In-World Items obtained on Nintendo Switch have been changed so that they can only be used when playing the Nintendo Switch version.
- If players were playing on a platform other than Nintendo Switch before the update, a confirmation dialog will appear to link Items in the World to the platform they are playing on.
- If playing on an unlinked platform, players will not possess any of the Items acquired in the World.
- The newly added settings, such as the option to skip platform linking confirmation, can be changed in the "Account Related Settings" on the "Account Screen".

・Made changes so that uploaded skins in the Community Market cannot be managed in the Nintendo Switch version where uploads are not possible.

With the completion of reimbursements today, the acceptance of cash refund requests that were temporarily suspended have been resumed.
The deadline for the next reimbursement application is on the 24th (Wednesday, JST).

We apologize for the sudden changes at this time. 
Please send any questions or concerns through the Inquiry form; the team will respond to them individually. 

We will continue to work hard to ensure that everyone can enjoy Teravit.
Thank you for your continued support of Teravit.

notes.title: 【Important】Announcement regarding account linking for players on Steam
notes.content:
Hi everyone. This is the Teravit Operation Team. From the update on Thursday, June 29th, 2023, account linkage with an email address and the Steam account will be enabled. By linking the account, players will be able to play with the Steam account data on the Teravit PC version. Vice-versa, players will also be able to sign in to the Steam version using the account created on the PC version. Due to this update, [b]account linkage in advance is necessary when applying for a cash redemption on the Creator's website.[/b] As for the players on the Steam version scheduling to apply for a cash redemption at the Creator's site, please follow the following procedure to link your account. [h2]How to link the email address[/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41224509/c38f3a1649979ca3e1b830aa0e296fe3bff232c0.png[/img] 1. Open the "Menu" on the bottom left of the home screen. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41224509/fb9de601e8eed6f1d5c963cbec5e460b4e07726b.png[/img] 2. Select "Account". [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41224509/8e364ceb272bc272d2e4727958a09883c7fb6d5a.png[/img] 3. Select "Link Account". [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41224509/8136941676ce60b1cb8971e305b46346d6e6b3dd.png[/img] 4. Enter the email address and password to be used for account linking. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41224509/bce2d9214c1756802995824a86fef5e1a7403a5e.png[/img] 5. Follow the instructions in the verification email sent to the registered email address to complete the verification process. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41224509/cb7e48d6e6b35f0a3e49f1124872c6f6012cc58c.png[/img] 6. Once the verification completes, you will be redirected back to the home screen.

How to sign in with the account created on the PC version

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41224509/c38f3a1649979ca3e1b830aa0e296fe3bff232c0.png[/img] 1. Open the "Menu" on the bottom left of the home screen. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41224509/2c62db6de3004957cf204bf01b7b2480f8dac2e0.png[/img] 2. Select "Sign in to existing account". [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41224509/8f23eae67e997706da1edefa494aff8b40d71f64.png[/img] 3. Enter the information required for signing in. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41224509/bcc90ac3747d73eacedc5efec63082a73b8b2787.png[/img] 4. After signing in, you will be redirected back to the home screen. [b]・By signing out, you will return to your Steam version account. ・Jewels purchased on the Steam version account cannot be used on the PC version.[/b]

notes.title: “TERAVIT” A Sandbox Game Created by Players
notes.content:
[h1]“TERAVIT” A Sandbox Game Created by Players Announcing a new “Create to Earn” game model and logo!
Parkour World made by Players Unveiled
[/h1]
After receiving all the feedback from the beta test, we went back to the drawing board to reconsider the direction of "Teravit" and to develop the game in a way which provides satisfaction to all our players. With that in mind, we are back now with an exciting announcement to bring everyone up to date on the changes that have been made since our last update!

CyberStep,Inc. is pleased to announce a new “Create to Earn” game model  for “Teravit” where profits are returned to the "creators" of the world.
In line with this new game model, the logo for the title is also renewed.
We are also pleased to announce that we have published parkour worlds created  by several actual players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41224509/9c2ca61f20594cf17fa0592d9360c31c7a4b18e2.png[/img]

[b]Introduction video of the parkour worlds created by players.[/b]
[previewyoutube=xsLfyEmkAVY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Announcing the new game model “Create to Earn” and the new logo![/h3]
Players of “Teravit” are now both “Players” and “Creators” of their own world. They can freely create and upload their original world online.
In “Teravit”, a new game style called "Create to Earn" is currently in development. Creators can set items to be sold within the world, and profits are returned based on the amount of purchases. They can also be rewarded when their uploaded worlds are played by others.
We are also introducing a new logo to better represent the "Platform" where unique metaverses created by players using the “Create to Earn" feature exist in many unique ways. It’s also of course possible to just play the “Game”, i.e. play inside the worlds created by other players.

[h3]Introducing Parkour Worlds made by Creators![/h3]
The parkour worlds introduced here are game worlds created by combining various gimmicks that are actually available in the game.
Share these game worlds with your friends and players around the world. Enjoy the unique gameplay and game creation that only "Teravit" can offer.

[h3]About “Teravit”[/h3]
“Teravit” is a brand new Free-to-play sandbox-style game.

In “Teravit”, players can create a beautiful voxel world by using various blocks and adding different game elements in the world to create and enjoy original game content.
With the multiplayer feature, the game is now [b]“A Sandbox Game Created by Players”[/b]: Players can cooperate online with friends to create game worlds, and let other players enjoy their content by uploading them online.
